filters.description: The filters to apply to the list of people. Use them to reduce the size of the response.

count.description: The maximum number of items to be retrieved in the response.

items.description:
The fields to include in the response.

id - The user ID.
displayName - The user display name.
isAnonim - Specifies if the user is anonymous or not.
email - The user email.
birthday - The user birthday.
status - The user status.
department - The user department.
isAdmin - Specifies if the user is an administrator or not.
isRoomAdmin - Specifies if the user is a room administrator or not.
isOwner - Specifies if the user is a portal owner or not.
isVisitor - Specifies if the user is a portal visitor or not.
isCollaborator - Specifies if the user is a portal collaborator or not.

filterSeparator.description: Represents the separator used to split filter criteria in query parameters.

filterValue.description: The search text used to filter results based on user input.

sortBy.description: Specifies the property or field name by which the results should be sorted.

sortOrder.description:
The order in which the results are sorted.

0 - Ascending order
1 - Descending order

startIndex.description: The zero-based index of the first item to be retrieved in a filtered result set.

count.description: The number of items in the response.

links.description: The links related to the response.

isAnonim.description: Specifies if the user is anonymous or not.

status.description: The status of the API response.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status code of the API response.

total.description: The total number of items available.
